checks.description: contributions that no process record contains
checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a del:Contribution FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?pr del:hasContribution ?c } }

checks.description: contributions with no anchor and no routing decision by a person into one of the three categories
checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a del:Contribution FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?c del:hasAnchor ?a } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?c px:hasRoutingDecision ?d . ?d px:routingCategory ?k ; prov:wasAttributedTo ?p . ?p a prov:Person FILTER(?k IN ('no_provision', 'uncertain_prediction', 'out_of_scope')) } }

checks.description: anchors without a method or without their own status (confirmed, contested, not applicable)
checks.query: SELECT ?a WHERE { ?a a del:LegalResourceAnchor FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?a del:anchorMethod ?m ; px:anchorStatus ?s FILTER(?s IN ('confirmed', 'contested', 'not_applicable')) } }

checks.description: anchors without a method or without their own status (confirmed, contested, not applicable)
checks.query: SELECT ?a WHERE { ?a a del:LegalResourceAnchor FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?a del:anchorMethod ?m ; px:anchorStatus ?s FILTER(?s IN ('confirmed', 'contested', 'not_applicable')) } }

checks.description: provisions a contribution is about or proposes to change that have no anchor naming them in their own expression
checks.query: SELECT ?c ?p WHERE { ?c a del:Contribution ; del:aboutProvision|del:proposesChangeTo ?p . ?p del:partOfExpression ?e FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?c del:hasAnchor ?a . ?a del:anchorProvision ?p ; del:anchorExpression ?e } }

checks.description: provisions a contribution is about or proposes to change that have no anchor naming them in their own expression
checks.query: SELECT ?c ?p WHERE { ?c a del:Contribution ; del:aboutProvision|del:proposesChangeTo ?p . ?p del:partOfExpression ?e FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?c del:hasAnchor ?a . ?a del:anchorProvision ?p ; del:anchorExpression ?e } }

checks.description: live query of 15 October 2026: anchors whose expression differs from the expression the contribution references
checks.query: SELECT ?c ?a WHERE { ?pr del:hasContribution ?c . ?c del:hasAnchor ?a ; del:references ?e1 . ?a del:anchorExpression ?e2 FILTER(?e1 != ?e2) }

checks.description: aggregates whose declared number of contributions differs from the contributions they are derived from
checks.query: SELECT ?g ?n ?k WHERE { { SELECT ?g ?n (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?k) WHERE { ?g a px:Aggregate ; px:declaredCount ?n OPTIONAL { ?g prov:wasDerivedFrom ?c . ?c a del:Contribution } } GROUP BY ?g ?n } FILTER(?k != ?n) }

checks.description: contributions on the provision an aggregate covers that are neither in the aggregate nor recorded as excluded
checks.query: SELECT ?g ?c WHERE { ?g a px:Aggregate ; px:aggregateScope ?p ; px:declaredCount ?n . ?c a del:Contribution ; del:aboutProvision ?p FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?g prov:wasDerivedFrom ?c } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?x a px:Exclusion ; px:excludes ?c ; px:fromAggregate ?g } }

checks.description: exclusions from an aggregate without a recorded reason
checks.query: SELECT ?x WHERE { ?x a px:Exclusion FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?x px:reason ?r } }

checks.description: corrections of a label that an aggregate is derived from, which do not name that aggregate
checks.query: SELECT ?r ?g WHERE { ?r a del:AnnotationResponse ; del:actionType 'corrected' ; del:respondsToAnnotation ?l . ?g a px:Aggregate ; prov:wasDerivedFrom ?l FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?r px:affectsAggregate ?g } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?g prov:wasDerivedFrom ?r } }

checks.description: aggregates named by a correction for which no revision derived from that correction exists
checks.query: SELECT ?r ?g WHERE { ?r a del:AnnotationResponse ; px:affectsAggregate ?g FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?g2 prov:wasRevisionOf ?g ; prov:wasDerivedFrom ?r } }

checks.description: current aggregates (not revised) whose value differs from a recount of their labels after corrections
checks.query: SELECT ?g ?v ?recount WHERE { ?g a px:Aggregate ; px:aggregateValue ?v FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?g2 prov:wasRevisionOf ?g } { SELECT ?g (SUM(IF(?eff = ?lab, 1, 0)) AS ?recount) WHERE { ?g px:countsLabel ?lab ; prov:wasDerivedFrom ?l . ?l a del:StanceAnnotation OPTIONAL { ?l del:stanceLabel ?orig } OPTIONAL { ?r a del:AnnotationResponse ; del:actionType 'corrected' ; del:respondsToAnnotation ?l ; del:correctedTo ?ct } BIND(COALESCE(?ct, ?orig) AS ?eff) } GROUP BY ?g } FILTER(?recount != ?v) }

checks.description: corrections whose original annotation no longer carries its label (stance, fallacy or generic label)
checks.query: SELECT ?r ?l WHERE { ?r a del:AnnotationResponse ; del:actionType 'corrected' ; del:respondsToAnnotation ?l FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?l del:stanceLabel|del:annotationLabel|del:identifiesFallacy ?x } }

checks.description: contributions with no recorded status, individually or as an enumerated member of a group
checks.query: SELECT ?c WHERE { ?pr del:hasContribution ?c FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?s a px:ContributionStatus { ?s px:statusOf ?c } UNION { ?s px:statusOf ?grp . ?grp px:hasMember ?c } } }

checks.description: statuses recorded for a group that does not name its members
checks.query: SELECT ?s ?grp WHERE { ?s a px:ContributionStatus ; px:statusOf ?grp . ?grp a px:ContributionGroup FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?grp px:hasMember ?m } }

checks.description: examined statuses lacking who responds, outcome, reasons, date or procedural reference
checks.query: SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a px:ContributionStatus ; px:status 'examined' FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?s prov:wasAttributedTo ?w ; px:outcome ?o ; px:reason ?r ; px:asOf ?d ; px:proceduralReference ?pr } }
SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a px:ContributionStatus ; px:status 'excluded' FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?s px:reason ?r } }

checks.description: absences of response recorded without a date
checks.query: SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a px:ContributionStatus ; px:status 'unanswered' FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?s px:asOf ?d } }
